text:
Platinum Price in 2022
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2022, the LBMA platinum price rose 0.9% between 2022-01-31 ($1,022) and 2022-12-29 ($1,031). The highest sampled price was $1,063 in February and the lowest was $845 in August. The mean of these observations was $955. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
What happened in 2022:
The highest inflation in four decades and aggressive rate hikes produced volatile, range-bound metals prices.
